notes.title: Update(190122)
notes.notes:
[New]

 Add Language switch and add support for Traditional Chinese . Japanses will come later .
 Add FX when destroy objects , for the coming new weapon system.


[Fix]

 Correct typo in English messages.
 Fix Ship cannot fly to downway near player.


[ps.]

 The ship base on a Power System , most parts on ship need to cast power to make active , and some parts can get additional Power , now there is no hint to show part data and hard to know part is active or not , will quickly deal with it .
